# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest release through the hotfix process into
`master`, then synchronize into `develop`. See [Releasing](RELEASING.md).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/2chevskii/go-hexcore/security/advisories/new)
to submit a confidential report. If it is unavailable, email
[prsroman3@gmail.com](mailto:prsroman3@gmail.com) with the subject
`go-hexcore security report`.

Include the affected version or commit, a description of the impact, and a
minimal reproduction or proof of concept. Use synthetic data; do not include
live credentials or private account details. Keep vulnerabilities out of public
issues, discussions, and pull requests while investigation is in progress.

The maintainer will investigate and coordinate a fix and disclosure where
appropriate. Report vulnerabilities in the HexCore hosting service directly to
HexCore; this repository maintains the Go client.
